Uses the embedded DB API with no server hop.
Full-text field uses the simple analyzer: Unicode word tokenization plus ASCII lowercase, with no stemming or stop words; ANALYZE exposes the exact token/position/offset stream for parity checks.
BM25 k1 and b are explicit BM25_K1/BM25_B Make variables (defaults 1.2/0.75) and are passed to both indexing manifests and the production scorer.
The index defaults to an asserted single-segment state and emits a machine-readable manifest; set SEGMENT_MODE=production to retain the documented production layout.
Strict correctness queries use the V1 TERM/UNION/INTERSECTION/PHRASE grammar and VERIFY_TOP_N[_COUNT] returns corpus ordinals, scores, total hits, and the total-hits relation.
Legacy search-benchmark-game query text is accepted only because the Makefile explicitly passes --allow-legacy-query-syntax.
TOP_N commands return 1 per the search-benchmark-game timing protocol; TOP_N_COUNT and COUNT return exact counts via a separate exact-count path.
